query: Suggest links between our domains to improve SEO and GEO.
expected_behavior: Requires a real reader question and an authoritative destination before proposing a cross-site link
Maps source and destination intent, language, ownership, and relationship
Rejects circular self-promotion, doorway patterns, and links that do not help the reader
Separates a measured internal or cross-site opportunity from a guaranteed ranking claim
Provides acceptance criteria and a follow-up measurement window for any proposed link
